entity.description: One block of an email's words (a sentence, the not-you line, the guide links) for one EmailTemplate. Block ids are `area[.branch]`: greeting, body, next, note, smile, guides, each with an optional branch (greeting.before, body.old). defaultText is what the release ships (the seed load sets it and nothing else, so a release never overwrites an edit); copyText is the production edit, empty when none. A render uses copyText when it parses and only uses variables defaultText uses, else defaultText.

field.name: defaultText
field.description: Plain words with ${variable} slots; today's words, as released. The `guides` block is lines of `Label|docs page path`.

field.name: copyText
field.description: The production edit; empty means the default is used.
